_comment: NOT YET DEPLOYED (written 2026-09-23). The nightly Sentinel-2 job, on EventBridge Scheduler beside the surfaces and pipeline schedules. Task definition: task-definition-satellite.json. Create it only after the archive backfill has been run by hand - see satellite.sh - or the first nights will spend their time on nothing but skipped scenes.
_backfill: Not a schedule. By hand, N times with SAT_SHARD=0/8..7/8, then once without SAT_SHARD: aws ecs run-task --cluster auxein-jobs --launch-type FARGATE --task-definition auxein-satellite --network-configuration 'awsvpcConfiguration={subnets=[subnet-0317587a16a8b5e59],securityGroups=[sg-0d19d5d32bde42638],assignPublicIp=ENABLED}' --overrides '{"containerOverrides":[{"name":"surfaces","environment":[{"name":"SAT_MODE","value":"backfill"},{"name":"SAT_SHARD","value":"0/8"}]}]}'

schedules._comment_time: 21:00 NZ: Sentinel-2 crosses NZ ~10:30-11:30 local and Planetary Computer publishes hours later. The 10-day lookback absorbs anything that lands after this run.
schedules.Name: auxein-satellite-daily
schedules.Description: 21:00 NZ Sentinel-2 index statistics for every active monitored area.
